about: Every poll in Wikipedia's polling tables for the 2020-03-02 election, from the day after the previous election (2019-09-17) to the day before the vote, newest first: 80 polls by 12 pollsters (6 by Shlomo Filber's firms). The outgoing Knesset was dissolved on 2019-12-12 (60 polls since). Same schema as the 28-day files in data/, with the same lists, blocs, agreements and result as data/2020-03.json; parties that merged, split or withdrew during the campaign have their own ids, listed in otherLists (`into` names the final list they merged into). Built by scripts/forecast/backtest/build-data-full.py; memo docs/research/polls-method/round2/D1-data-full.md.
blocNote: Netanyahu bloc as Wikipedia's 'Gov.' column and calibration.json count it: Likud, Shas, UTJ, Yamina. Yisrael Beiteinu is 'mid'; Otzma Yehudit 'mid' as in Sep 2019 (failed).
